features.name: Index Management Page
features.description: A new hidden page that allows users to view and manage indexes on tables, showing index key names and detailed information about each index.
caveats: Page location is not well discoverable
Non-AL defined indexes shown but naming may change

features.name: Enable/Disable Indexes
features.description: Users can disable indexes immediately and enable them on-demand. In SaaS environments, enabling happens overnight in local time. In Docker and on-premises, changes happen immediately.
caveats: Non-AL defined indexes cannot be re-enabled once removed
Primary keys, system ID, sift, and unique indexes cannot be disabled
Per-company enabling for company tables only

features.name: Per-Company Index Management
features.description: For company tables, indexes can now be managed on a per-company basis, allowing selective enable/disable at the company level. Indexes can be defined with enable false in AL and selectively enabled at runtime for specific companies.
caveats: Method to enable indices as part of setup code is currently on-prem scope only
Cloud scope availability is being considered for future release

features.name: Index Usage Statistics
features.description: New visibility into index usage through seek, scan, lookup, and update counts that show how often SQL Server uses each index. Statistics are cumulative since the last database restart and include timestamps showing when SQL Server last used each index.
caveats: Statistics reset on database restart
Placeholder date formatting in current version
Requires sufficient time window to be meaningful
Usage stats reflect back to the last time the database was restarted
Data becomes more useful after extended periods since restart

features.name: Index Storage Information on Table Information Page
features.description: The table information page now shows aggregate size of all indexes alongside data size, helping users understand storage consumption by indexes.

features.name: Index storage metrics
features.description: Display of per-index storage consumption to identify indices consuming excessive disk space.

features.name: Index fragmentation metrics
features.description: Display of fragmentation percentage for indices, with note that this metric is less important on modern SSDs compared to spinning disk drives.
caveats: Fragmentation metric is less critical on SSDs than on spinning disk drives
Not consequential for datasets under 1,000 rows

features.name: Telemetry for Index Changes
features.description: Users can check telemetry to see if indexes have been disabled and track when they were applied, enabling performance troubleshooting.
caveats: Telemetry does not show immediate performance impact when index changes are applied overnight

features.name: Non-AL Defined Indexes
features.description: System automatically creates and maintains non-AL defined indexes on tables. These indexes may appear in the index management page but have different management rules than AL-defined indexes.
caveats: Final naming may differ from current preview
Cannot be re-enabled once removed

features.name: Database missing indexes advisor
features.description: Feature showing which indexes SQL Server wishes it had to improve query planning, providing suggestions for potential new indices.
caveats: Index usage stats can only reflect on indices that already exist

features.name: Just-in-time index enabling
features.description: Ability to enable indices temporarily for specific periods like yearly closing cycles, disabled most of the year to reduce storage and write costs.

features.name: Disabled index management for archived data
features.description: Strategy to disable indices on backup companies to reduce storage costs, applicable to archived or backed-up company copies.

features.name: Auto-created index cleanup
features.description: Ability to disable automatically created indices that were generated during setup or testing and are no longer needed after customer deployment.
caveats: Indices not defined in a key in AL that are disabled will be deleted
SQL Server-generated indices can be recreated if needed

features.name: DAMS - Data Administration and Management Service
features.description: Automatic service running behind the scenes that handles database maintenance, monitoring, and tuning including index rebuild, statistics updates, and database advisor recommendations.

features.name: Automatic index rebuild
features.description: DAMS performs nightly fragmentation and page density calculations for large tables, rebuilding indices with greater than 25% fragmentation during off-hours with low priority.
caveats: Checking fragmentation levels for large companies takes time each night
Backup companies can negatively impact nightly maintenance performance

features.name: Automatic statistics updates
features.description: Statistics are automatically updated both on a nightly basis and when SQL Server detects after n amount of changes to data.

features.name: DAMS re-index stats table
features.description: Table that stores index rebuild information from DAMS operations to track maintenance history and optimize future runs.
caveats: Backup companies can negatively impact nightly fragmentation checking performance

features.name: Automatic Database Tuning Advisor
features.description: DAMS runs Database Tuning Advisor tool investigating top consuming queries when CPU usage is high, automatically generating indices it recommends, typically prefixed with _DTA or _NCI.
caveats: Approximately 40,000 databases have auto-created indices from DAMS
DAMS re-index stats table itself is identified as missing an index

features.name: Extension fields merging to base tables in version 29
features.description: In version 29, extension fields will be merged back into the base table in SQL schema instead of being stored in separate companion tables. This allows creating keys on extension fields and improves runtime operations.
caveats: No exact shipping date promised
Upgrade may take longer with many table extensions and data
Theoretical record max length concern identified but rare

features.name: Index management upgrade performance impact
features.description: Runtime operations will be faster with merged extension fields. Inserts reduce from two SQL inserts to one by removing joins. Upgrade itself may take longer than other major versions when merging extensions.
caveats: Amount of data to move is main concern
Mileage will vary based on customer settings

features.name: Indexes list part page
features.description: A page for managing indexes created and published as open source in BC apps repository. Users can contribute improvements via pull request.

features.name: Record length validation in version 28
features.description: Change rolling out to version 28 that validates whether databases are close to the SQL Server record max length limit and issues a warning, prompting consideration of removing extensions.
caveats: Only four databases found with potential issue in telemetry
No dual mode offered - must choose to remove extensions if needed

features.name: Index maintenance window scheduling
features.description: System currently does not follow upgrade window for index maintenance. Proposal under consideration to allow specifying a maintenance window for index operations and other system tasks. Job queue entries could also be scheduled to run in maintenance window.
caveats: Currently separate from upgrade window and non-configurable
Some app service-wide constraints prevent making all tenants happy simultaneously
Still being evaluated for feasibility

features.name: SIFT index management in future
features.description: SIFT indexes remain relevant for flow fields and subindex fields. Include columns feature can replace SIFT indexes in many cases by adding include columns to well-defined indexes. Full management of SIFT indexes planned for future addition to index management feature.
features.status_evidence_quote: the full management of sift indexes we plan to add that to the index management later
caveats: Delivery iterative based on feedback
Include columns feature is underutilized

features.name: Index virtual provider API expansion to cloud
features.description: Index virtual provider and related APIs currently scope on-premises only. Plan to enable these features moving forward for cloud, with filtering by table to avoid expensive operations across all indexes and tables.
caveats: Currently on-premises only in version 20.4
Concerns about making it too easy for users to hurt themselves
Requires filtering by table due to performance cost
